title: Evaluation identifies germs of locally constant maps with the fibre
statement: Let U be a topological space, x a point of U, and R a set. A map from an open subset V of U to R is locally constant if every point of V has an open neighbourhood in V on which the map is constant. For each open neighbourhood V of x let L_R(V) be the set of such maps. Let L_R,x be their colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] over the open neighbourhoods of x ordered by reverse inclusion, with coprojections sending g to its germ g_x. There is a unique evaluation map from L_R,x to R sending g_x to g(x), and it is bijective.

source.place: Sheaves, Example Tag 007B, line 995, together with Definition Tag 006W

proof.text: Choose for each stalk element a representative using Mathlib TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq. Define evaluation to be the value of this representative at x. For any other representative of the same germ, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_eq gives equal restrictions on a common neighbourhood; evaluating these at x proves the evaluation formula. Every stalk element has a representative, so the formula also proves uniqueness.

proof.text: The map ev_x is surjective: for each r in R, the constant map U to R with value r is locally constant, and the germ of this map at x is sent by ev_x to r.

source.place: Example Tag 007B (example-stalk-constant-presheaf), lines 994-1005, using the description of the constant sheaf in Definition Tag 006W

proof.text: Represent the two stalk elements by ga on Va and gb on Vb using TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq. The evaluation formula shows that their values at x agree. IsLocallyConstant.isOpen_fiber gives open fibres of these point values in Va and Vb. Their images in X are open because the inclusions of open subspaces are open maps. Intersect these images to obtain a common open neighbourhood of x. The two restrictions there are equal by LocallyConstant.ext, since each equals its value at x. Apply TopCat.Presheaf.germ_ext to obtain equality of the germs.

lean.statement: theorem existsUnique_locallyConstant_germ_evaluation (X : TopCat.{u}) (x : X) (R : Type u) : let L : X.Presheaf (Type u) := { obj := fun V ↦ LocallyConstant {y : X // y ∈ unop V} R map := fun {U V} i ↦ TypeCat.ofHom (LocallyConstant.comap ⟨fun y : {y : X // y ∈ unop V} ↦ ⟨y.1, i.unop.le y.2⟩, continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _⟩) map_id := by intros; rfl map_comp := by intros; rfl } ∃ ev : L.stalk x → R, (∀ (V : Opens X) (hx : x ∈ V) (g : LocallyConstant V R), ev (L.germ V x hx g) = g ⟨x, hx⟩) ∧ Function.Bijective ev ∧ ∀ ev' : L.stalk x → R, (∀ (V : Opens X) (hx : x ∈ V) (g : LocallyConstant V R), ev' (L.germ V x hx g) = g ⟨x, hx⟩) → ev' = ev
